prompt: Match each input of a model to what keeps its versions in this lesson.
Why is a large data file kept in DVC rather than committed to Git?

choices.text: Git refuses files over one megabyte
choices.why: It accepts them; it just carries them in every clone forever.

choices.text: Git is built for text
choices.why: Right. DVC keeps the bytes elsewhere and a small pointer in Git that names them exactly.

choices.text: DVC compresses SQLite better
choices.why: Compression is not the reason.

choices.text: Data must never be versioned
choices.why: They must be; that is DVC's job.

prompt: Why does the lesson set git config user.name and user.email before anything else?

choices.text: MLflow uses them to log in to its server
choices.why: The local server has no login.

choices.text: Git refuses to commit without an identity

choices.text: They choose the remote DVC pushes to
choices.why: The remote is set with dvc remote add.

prompt: What is a DVC remote for?

choices.text: Holding the Git history of the code

choices.text: A safe copy of the cache

choices.text: Tracking MLflow runs
